# minimal-custom-0.3.0

A minimal custom Nextflow pipeline with no `nextflow_schema.json`, no
`modules.json`, no `modules/` directory and no nf-core conventions: one
inline process tiles H&E whole-slide images. It checks that nf-splice
reports what it cannot know instead of assuming nf-core structure. It is
never run; the files are byte-exact test data.
